packageRules.description: Keep Docker images (Dockerfile + compose) pinned to a digest, and bump the digest when the upstream tag is rebuilt.
Go patch updates are low-risk; batch them into one PR to keep review noise down.

Bump the go directive in go.mod to each new Go release. Renovate's default treats it as a minimum and never proposes it. CI's setup-go reads go.mod, so it must follow the golang image. See https://docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/gomod/
One PR per Go release: the golang build image and the go/toolchain directives in go.mod move together. Must stay below 'go patch updates' so this groupName wins for the go directive.
